Name: Marry Me - Reverse Wedding Proposals
Author: Kantrip
Description:
[color=#d5a6bd][size=5][b]## Features:[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][size=3][b]A custom proposal event[/b] for each of the twelve original suitors[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]A default proposal event[/b] for modded NPCs (if enabled by the mod author)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]﻿[b]A desperate proposal event[/b] — a special event that happens when a character wants to propose, but the farmer is also dating someone else at the same time. (This can be turned off).[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Choose between 2nd or 3rd person narration[/b]: (“Abigail takes your hands” vs “Abigail takes the farmer’s hands”). Configurable as a mod setting.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Real, working engagements:[/b] no mermaid's pendant required (though the NPC will give you one instead!)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]SVE compatibility:[/b] all SVE marriage candidates can now trigger the Default Proposal (minus the Wizard)[/size][/*]
[/list][color=#d5a6bd][size=5][b]
## White Events and Black Events:
[/b][/size][/color][size=3]To trigger a character’s normal (white) proposal, you need to be at 10 hearts with a character. There are additional time and weather constraints for some events, so be sure to check the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/3367]Event Triggers article[/url] for details.[/size]

[size=3]Black proposals (if enabled) are triggered if a white proposal would normally be triggered, BUT the farmer is dating more than one person at the same time. If more than one NPC meets those conditions, a random suitor one will be chosen.[/size]

[size=3]Half of the black proposals trigger on rainy days, the other half in sun. Check the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/3367]Event Triggers article[/url] for the appropriate weather conditions if you are trying to see a specific one. And yes, there’s a black proposal for modded NPCs, too (which can be enabled by that mod's author).[/size]

[b][color=#d5a6bd][size=5]## Recommended Mods:[/size][/color]
[/b][size=3]Each event comes with a mermaid’s pendant, so please note that you will need a free slot in your inventory for these events to trigger. And, while I can’t make that pendant into a wearable piece of equipment, please check out the following recommended Fashion Sense mods for that extra bit of immersion:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13098]FS Mermaid Pendant for Farmer[/url]﻿[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34928]FS Wearable Mermaid Pendant Accessory[/url][/size]﻿﻿[/*]
[/list][size=3]
Other mods that pair nicely with Marry Me: Reverse Wedding Proposals:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][size=3]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29885]Custom Wedding Ceremony[/url][/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32078]Wedding Anniversaries[/url] [/size][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]
There's also a special proposal for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31574]Kantrip's Older Sebastian[/url].
[b]NOTE: [/b]There is a setting which will allow you to enable proposals while married to someone else. This has no effect unless you've installed one of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10021]Free Love[/url], or [url=https://github.com/EnderTedi/Polyamory]Polyamory (beta)[/url].[/size]

[b][color=#d5a6bd][size=5]## Installation:[/size][/color]
[/b][size=3]Marry Me: Reverse Proposals contains two mods in one folder. You need both. If you are installing this manually, just download the zip and extract the files, then put the "Marry Me" folder into your mods folder (it contains the other two mods).

[b]Marry Me[/b]                        <-- this is the base folder. [b]Put this into your Mods folder.[/b]
 / [CP] Marry Me             <-- these are all of the proposal events  (ID = Kantrip.MarryMe)
 / ReverseProposals        <-- this is the C# mod required to make engagements work  (ID = Kantrip.ReverseProposals)[/size]


[b][color=#d5a6bd][size=5]## Compatibility:[/size][/color]
[/b][size=3]Previously, event mods that changed the 10 heart event ID were incompatible with this mod. That changed with version 1.3. If you previously experienced issues with event mods (Immersive Shane, Miihau's Shane Event Expansion, etc), they should now work with this mod.

[b][color=#ff00ff]This mod now has specific compatibility for SVE characters[/color][/b] (Claire, Lance, Olivia, Scarlett, Sophia, Victor). They do not have custom events, but all of them can now access the Default Proposal (wishing well). I have not enabled this for the Wizard (even with SVE installed), because a proposal would be lore-incompatible with the Wizard's 14heart SVE event.[/size]

[color=#e06666][size=4][b]Incompatible:[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3][b]Maggs Immersive Sebastian[/b] - this mod explicitly disables Sebastian's Marry Me proposal event[/size]

[color=#d5a6bd][size=5][b]## Credits:[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]Special thanks goes to The Consouls for allowing me to use their jazz rendition of the Night Market theme (composed by Concerned Ape) in this mod. Find the full song and many other excellent video game jazz covers on their [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jmYUUTyGO6o]YouTube channel[/url]﻿, or at their [url=https://www.patreon.com/c/TheConsoulsBand/]Patreon[/url]﻿.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#d5a6bd]## A Note to Translators:[/color]
[/b][/size][size=3]This mod plays around with pronouns in a way that might make translation into your chosen language difficult. I'm accomplishing the 2nd/3rd person switch by using a set of custom [/size][b]{{You}}[/b][size=3] / [/size][b]{{Your}}[/b][size=3] tokens in the event dialogue.[/size]

[size=3][b]If these tokens make no sense for your language, IGNORE THEM[/b] and just choose one set of pronouns to translate for. The tokens have absolutely no effect on dialogue lines that don't call them. To inform users of your choice, please note that the mod has translation keys for all of the Configuration settings as well; just let users know that the [b]SecondPersonNarration[/b] flag won't have any effect with your translation.[/size]

[size=3](If you really want to support both 2nd and 3rd person dialogue, you can always make two translation files and allow the user to choose which one they want. The mod config toggle won't work, but just mark it clearly so people don't get confused.)[/size]

[size=3]Thank you in advance to everyone who undertakes translation of this mod, and I apologize for the slight weirdness xD[/size]

[color=#d5a6bd][size=5][b]## A Note to Mod Authors:
[/b][/size][/color][size=3]This mod can provide default white and black proposals for your custom NPC, but will play neither unless you enable them within your own mod. Please see [url=https://github.com/Kantrip-Mods/SDV/tree/main/ReverseProposals]the GitHub[/url] for details on adding Reverse Proposal support, and/or adding custom Proposal events.[/size]
